caelen.speaker: CAELEN
caelen.text: They never finished it. Something is still building.

seraphine.speaker: SERAPHINE
seraphine.text: The sky is darker over it. Even the corona looks tired.

nimue.speaker: NIMUE
nimue.text: A whole city under the water, and they built on top of it.

voice.speaker: VOICE
voice.text: You have stopped the work. You have not stopped the reason for it.

voice2.speaker: VOICE
voice2.text: Every living thing burns a little of the light that is left. Mine do not.

voice3.speaker: VOICE
voice3.text: Look at the sun. Then tell me I am wrong.

caelen.speaker: CAELEN
caelen.text: Maybe the light is going. That was never yours to decide for us.

seraphine.speaker: SERAPHINE
seraphine.text: The Oracle wanted everyone still. So do you. Neither of you asked.

nimue.speaker: NIMUE
nimue.text: You put a price on everyone and never asked if they'd sell.

orion.speaker: ORION
orion.text: I cannot tell you it is wrong. I can tell you it never asked.

orion2.speaker: ORION
orion2.text: It is certain. I told you to watch the certain ones.
